nodes.name: WhatsApp Trigger
nodes.notes: Select your existing WhatsApp OAuth credential. Publish only after disabling the old workflow.

nodes.name: Bot का जवाब (Postgres)
nodes.notes: Select the same PostgreSQL database as Adminer and the app. Run whatsapp-schema.sql first.

nodes.name: WhatsApp JSON भेजो
nodes.notes: Replace PHONE_NUMBER_ID, not the mobile number. Header Auth credential: Name Authorization, Value Bearer YOUR_META_TOKEN. Never put the token in code.
